# PRD 009: docs in the pij CLI

| summary | The pij CLI carries its own documentation: a start page for an agent that has just met pij, and reference pages any seat can list and read in any repo. The first pages explain the fleet's constructs: role, type, position, pod and template. |

<a id="why"></a>

## Why

pij's documentation lives in three places a working seat often cannot reach. The skill is a set of job routes loaded one at a time by an agent that invokes it. `--help` covers one verb at a time. `docs/how/` is only in the pij repo, so a seat in another project cannot read it. `pij docs` is refused today as an unknown verb. There is no single page that says what a role, a type, a pod or a template is and how they relate, and the fleet's constructs are about to grow (PRDs 006, 007 and 008). A sibling tool already ships its docs inside its binary with a start page for agents, and that pattern has worked.

| a-maintainer | maintainer | Keep one copy of each page. |

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

| id | goal |
| --- | --- |
| g-1 | A seat in any repo answers "what is this and how do I use it" with one pij command. |
| g-2 | The docs a seat reads always match the pij it is running. |

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non goals

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| n-1 | Moving all of `docs/how/` into the CLI now. This PRD ships the start page and the pages for the fleet's constructs; the rest can follow. |
| n-2 | Replacing the skill. The skill keeps the judgment (when to create a role, which type fits); the CLI carries reference. |
| n-3 | A website or a search service. |
